# MM-P3-L4-SB03-S2 Fastener inspection and torque - Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-SB03

Scope
- Provides inspection and torque verification instructions for fasteners and access panels on EQ-P3-L4-SB03. Applies to maintenance personnel performing preventive or corrective work where fasteners are disturbed or reinstalled.
- Related documents: ECN-2026-026, MM-P3-L4-SB03, SB-1019

Tools
- Standard hand tools and calibrated torque wrench as provided by the plant tool crib.
- Clean lint-free rags and approved lubricant CFW-LUB-526 for fastener threads and contact surfaces.
- Safety PPE per facility policy and procedures in MM-P3-L4-SB03.

Procedure
- Isolate and lockout/tagout the equipment per plant LOTO policy and referenced procedures in MM-P3-L4-SB03 before accessing panels or fasteners on EQ-P3-L4-SB03.
- Inspect fastener condition for thread damage, corrosion, or distorted heads. Replace hardware per SB-1019 if defect prevents secure engagement.
- Clean mating surfaces and apply CFW-LUB-526 sparingly to threads where lubrication is required. Wipe excess from surrounding areas.
- Reinstall fasteners with correct engagement and seating. Use the calibrated torque wrench to apply specified torque values from ECN-2026-026 where applicable. Do not substitute values from other sources.
- After reassembly, perform a functional check of access panels and guards for correct alignment and secure attachment. Verify no loose hardware remains in the work area.

Acceptance criteria
- All reinstalled fasteners are seated, secured, and show no visible thread damage or galling. Lubricant used: CFW-LUB-526.
- No unsecured hardware or foreign material left in the cabinet or surrounding area.
- Dust collection system alarm status is normal; note that the dust collector pressure drop alarm for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is 1510 Pa. If the system reports the pressure drop alarm value, refer to ECN-2026-026 for corrective actions.
- Document work and torque values per MM-P3-L4-SB03 and file records per SB-1019.
